backend: Offline file URL, headless Google Chrome, SVG
fixture: Six rigid panels, fixed 40 mm depth; synthetic data only
fresh_browser_method: Close the exporting Chrome process before launching importing Chrome; no shared context or storage
read_failure_method: Test-only Blob.text fault for unreadable.json; all imports use the visible button and file chooser

scenarios.name: committed-only export with pending preview
scenarios.steps: Apply 24.5 mm / 60 degrees, select panel 5, measure crease 3; draft 27.1 / 22 and preview one tilt step; export via Enter.
scenarios.expected: Downloaded v1 JSON contains committed 24.5 / 60, panel 5 and measurement; pending preview and undo history are untouched.
scenarios.observed: Downloaded v1 JSON contains committed 24.5 / 60, panel 5 and measurement; pending preview and undo history are untouched.

scenarios.name: fresh browser import and reload/reimport
scenarios.steps: Close exporting Chrome; launch new offline Chrome. Import the actual download through the button/file chooser; edit pitch from flat and tilt from folded using handle keys, then undo; undo import; reload/reimport.
scenarios.expected: Both views, selection, exact values, comparison, measurement and trace match export. Imported work remains editable with shared undo; import is one undo step and works after reload.
scenarios.observed: Both views, selection, exact values, comparison, measurement and trace match export. Imported work remains editable with shared undo; import is one undo step and works after reload.

scenarios.name: atomic import, draft clearing and linked undo
scenarios.steps: Reload; commit 18.2 / 12, select panel 2; preview 21.3 / 10; import saved document; undo import, then undo earlier edit.
scenarios.expected: Import clears the preview. Undo restores previous committed geometry, panel 2 and detached measurement; next undo reaches baseline, with no phantom draft step.
scenarios.observed: Import clears the preview. Undo restores previous committed geometry, panel 2 and detached measurement; next undo reaches baseline, with no phantom draft step.

scenarios.name: invalid documents, picker cancellation, read failure and recovery
scenarios.steps: Commit 18.2 / 12, select panel 2, measure; retain an invalid numeric draft while trying malformed, foreign, incomplete, oversized and out-of-range documents plus a synthetic read failure. Repeat under a preview, correct the same file and import it.
scenarios.expected: All rejected imports preserve both views, controls, measurement, selection, pending edits and history. Cancellation is inert; same-file retry succeeds; undo order remains intact.
